title: Remove Covered Intervals
summary: Given intervals represented as [li, ri), remove those that are fully covered by another interval.
statement: Given intervals represented as [li, ri), remove those that are fully covered by another interval. An interval [a, b) is covered by [c, d) if c <= a and b <= d. Return the count of remaining intervals.
constraints: An interval is removed when another interval covers both its endpoints.
hints: Sort by start ascending and end descending.
Track the farthest right endpoint seen.
Count an interval only when its end extends beyond that frontier.
Earlier starts plus a no-smaller end exactly characterize coverage.
editorial: Earlier starts plus a no-smaller end exactly characterize coverage.

tests.explanation: Only [1,4] is covered by [2,8]? It is not; [3,6] is covered, leaving two intervals.
The longer interval covers the shorter one.
